v: Vivek Athreya + Nani handle a sensitive topic without turning it into a lecture 🙏 Funny, thoughtful, a little long... music could be better, but still a MUST WATCH for me.
e: Ante Sundaraniki succeeds at a difficult balance: it tackles sensitive social and family issues without turning into a lecture, while still giving Nani, Nazriya and the ensemble enough comedy to remain a mainstream entertainer. The runtime and music could be tighter, but the writing and performances make it a must watch.
body:
Another Excellent movie from Director Vivek Athreya….I believe for sensitive subjects that there is a thin line difference on how you handle the subject either stick to the topic and make it preachy and boring and add commercial elements and dilute the topic….Vivek and Nani knows how to play around by sticking to the core subject all along and also including proper entertainment for commercial purpose and never crossing the line…..All the artists Nazriya, Naresh, Rohini, Nadiya, Harshavardhan and all others did perfect justice to their roles, especially during the pre climax and climax 🙏…..Music & BGM should and must have been more effective!!!!

Considering how talented the director is and how terrific the actors are there is always a feel that the outcome could have been a bit more effective….The duration is debatable!!!

Overall this movie may not be as critically acclaimed as Mental Madhilo or Brochevarevura….but its still a MUST WATCH!!!

v: More FUN, less FRUSTRATION than F2 😄 Logic ni bayata parking lo pettesi vellandi. Venky Mama + Varun + Sunil + Vennela Kishore take care of the rest 😂
e: F3 makes no attempt to disguise what it is: an illogical comedy built around back-to-back episodes rather than a story anyone should analyse seriously. That approach works largely because Venkatesh dominates the film with his comic timing, while Varun Tej, Sunil and Vennela Kishore keep the energy high.
body:
for me when compared to #F2 this was more FUN and less FRUSTRATION not because of the plot but because of the artists or may be even because this time I was well prepared on what to expect!!!!

again….its VENKY Mama’s show all along and director Anil Ravapudi had made sure to utilise his terrific comedy timing to the fullest…..Varun Tej also did a very good job and would have been his best applauded performance if not sidelined by Venky’s comedy timing….

After many attempts….finally Suneel got a proper and full length comedy role to remind his glorious past but has been bit sidelined in the second half by Vennala Kishore….

Just like the Golmal and Housefull franchises in Hindi….here also audience would be least interested in the STORY and get entertained by what’s happening on the screen irrespective if it is logical or not and even the scene has any link to the storyline!!! Fortunately Anil had made sure to fill the whole movie with many such episodes which though illogical and doesn’t fit in the storyline still entertain the audience to the core….

We doesn’t even notice Devi Sri’s Songs and BGM….as well as other Technicalities in the movie…

v: Strictly average. Good core idea buried under full commercial khichdi 😪 Mahesh is the only real saving grace and once again makes me wonder why nobody gives this actor a proper challenge.
e: Sarkaru Vaari Paata starts from a relevant financial theme but loses focus by trying to simultaneously deliver comedy, sentiment, action, hero elevations and message-heavy dialogue. Mahesh Babu carries the film with ease, yet the writing gives him far less than his performance deserves.
body:
strictly average – Mahesh’s One man show and he is the only saving grace of this movie 🙏

In the era post the RRR’s and KGF’s either you need to strictly stick to the content without deviating OR stick to the genre OR create magic like KGF where you completely arrest the audience denying them to use their logical sense…..and in this era the normal “COMMERCIAL” movie which has a mix and match of everything is a gone case……

Parasuram has selected an interesting and relevant point…..but has completely messed it up by taking the commercial approach and trying to add Comedy, Sentiment, Action, Heroism and Dialogues!!!!

Don’t know about hardcore fans….but for me the Dialogues were completely irrelevant and meaningless and senseless…..I think in this new era where emotion is conveyed through Action and BGM, having lengthy and senseless dialogues is a crime….and dialogue writers should note that not every one is Balaya 😦

Mahesh literally showed the glimpses of what acting talent he had and its upto the directors to not waste it in silly Commercial Message oriented movies!!!!

v: DISASTER!!!! 🙏 Chiru + Charan together and still ZERO impact... that itself is some achievement. Almost every big moment reminded me of another movie that did it much better.
e: Acharya is one of those rare Chiranjeevi films that left almost no impression on me at all. Every major selling point had recently been delivered with more impact by another film, while the Chiranjeevi–Ram Charan combination feels driven more by commercial appeal than dramatic necessity.
body:
DISASTER!!!! when was the last time Chiru’s movie has left ZERO Impact (irrespective of Hit or Flop) for me it was Shankar Dada Zindabad and now Acharya took that spot!!!!

There was No Impact of the Story, as Akhanda has similar and more powerful story line!!!

There was no impact of the Violent Climax, as again Akhanda had more violence!!!

There was no impact of the elevation shots, as we all are in KGF elevation hangover!!!

There was no awe factor of the multi-starer , as RRR had a more awe feeling due to Ram and NTR combination!!!

There was no impact of the Father-Son combination, as Manam had a womderful Father-Son combination impact!!!

So to say there is nothing new to offer in this movie…nor what offered is impactful 🙏

Its end of Manisharma….Lahe Lahe had more impact due to its lyrics and other 3 songs reminded me of the late 90’s or early 20’s era 🙏….The movie would have had more impact without BGM 🤦‍♂️

And RamCharan’s Sidha’s role was added considering the commercial viability rather than any other importance….

Hope the BOSS will be back soon….
